integrity: The proof derives all commutation relations directly from the dihedral presentation. Exhaustive finite checks for 3<=n<=10 are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The commuting graph uses noncentral elements as vertices.
For odd n, total and paired dominating sets do not exist because reflections are isolated.
The theorem is restricted to ordinary dihedral groups D_{2n}; no extension to generalized quaternion or semidihedral groups is claimed.

An earlier 2010 paper on the same graph has only month-level online-publication evidence in the inspected source; the exact day used for archival dating is the later publisher-verified 29 April 2016 source.
title: Total and paired domination in commuting graphs of dihedral groups
